text: I'm looking after my granddaughter, she's 11. I think it's chickenpox, she's got the spots and they're itchy but otherwise she seems well enough I'd say. Runny nose too and lots of sneezing. Temperature was 39 when I checked, though I'm not sure the thermometer is the best one. She's weeing normally, so no worries there I don't think. Anything I should be doing for the fever?
